title: Ordering And Comparing Fractions — problem first

body.title: Ordering And Comparing Fractions — problem first

steps: Read the problem: Which is larger: 1/3 or 1/4?
Same numerator: smaller denominator means larger pieces.
Watch out: Adds numerators and denominators separately

body.misconception_check: If you thought differently, check: Adds numerators and denominators separately
